libraries.name: React
libraries.summary: The UI runtime every component layer here assumes: the 109 AI components, the shadcn-style records, and the dashboards all emit React TSX.

libraries.name: Tailwind CSS
libraries.summary: The styling layer the component and dashboard layers assume: every AI component and shadcn-style record emits Tailwind class strings, and the presets speak Tailwind color scales.

libraries.name: shadcn/ui
libraries.summary: Copy-in components wired on Radix primitives and Tailwind: the component layer here is shadcn-style, and the two dashboard starters are built on it.

libraries.name: Radix UI
libraries.summary: Unstyled accessible primitives (dialog, dropdown, tabs, tooltip): the behavior layer underneath shadcn and most of the 109 AI components.

libraries.name: Lucide icons
libraries.summary: The default icon set for shadcn and for most of the 109 AI components here (components.json sets iconLibrary to lucide).

libraries.name: Heroicons
libraries.summary: Tailwind Labs' icon set, made by the Tailwind team and a natural fit in Tailwind projects (the icons craft reference recommends it for Tailwind work).

libraries.name: Motion
libraries.summary: The animation library for React UIs (the package formerly published as framer-motion). The motion craft reference and several AI components assume it.

libraries.name: Google Fonts
libraries.summary: Hosted webfont service: the standard way to pull a typeface into a user project with two link tags, no npm dependency.

libraries.name: Fontsource
libraries.summary: Self-hosted webfonts as npm packages: the same open-source families Google Fonts serves, installed as a build-time dependency with no runtime request to Google.
